_readme: Hand-curated analyst notes shown in the detail panel. Keep them short, dated and sourced; update as events move.

hormuz.text: Shipping through the strait came to a near-total halt after US and Israeli strikes on Iran in late February, per the Joint Maritime Information Center.
Trackers still describe the strait as effectively closed; a brief June reopening did not last. Many vessels sail with AIS off, so PortWatch counts are a floor.

babelmandeb.text: Houthi attacks since late 2023 pushed much Asia–Europe traffic around the Cape; the Red Sea became more dangerous again in mid-2026.

suez.text: Some traffic returned to Suez in 2026 as Hormuz disruption reshuffled tanker routes, but Red Sea risk persists.
